content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Durgapur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Durgapur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the NIT Durgapur recruitment is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: NIT Durgapur is recruiting for two posts: Research Associate (RA-III) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Research Associate (RA-III) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the NIT Durgapur recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Research Associate (RA-III)?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Research Associate (RA-III) position is INR 67,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is INR 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview, which will be conducted in a hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted online through the official NIT Durgapur website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located at the National Institute of Technology Durgapur, Durgapur, West Bengal, with the pincode 713209.
